description: This Dart source file defines the `ExportService` class, which provides cross-platform file export functionalities, including exporting a sample PDF asset to user-chosen storage locations, using the `file_selector` package for file system interactions.

classes.name: ExportService
classes.description: A service class that manages exporting files, especially a sample PDF, to user-selected locations in a cross-platform manner.

methods.name: exportSamplePdfToUserLocation
methods.description: Exports a bundled sample PDF to the location chosen by the user using native save dialogs. Returns a confirmation message or throws an exception on failure.
